qft-01-c1.text: University of Edinburgh, School of Physics and Astronomy (2006). Quantum Physics 2006/07, Lecture 15: Special Relativity Review; the Klein Gordon Equation. University of Edinburgh lecture notes.
qft-01-c1.quote: The candidate for the probability density, ρ(x), is no longer positive definite
qft-01-c1.claim: admits negative-energy solutions and a charge density that isn't positive-definite, so it can't serve as a probability density.
